content:
Overview

Baden is a city in Aargau with a population of 20,000. A historic spa town in the Limmat Valley near Zurich, known for its Roman ruins, thermal baths, and as the global headquarters of ABB and Axpo. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
